priorFindingsCheck.priorFinding: iter2 spec_fidelity #2 — under-specified earn-line correlation: no stated key for picking the NEW earn-ledger line (tail vs WAKE_ID); concurrent/stale line could be mis-classified
priorFindingsCheck.evidence: behavioral-spec.md:128-136 ('Earn-ledger correlation key (WAKE_ID)') now states the loop forwards WAKE_ID (current wake ULID) to run.sh, run.sh stores it as the 'wake' field of every appended line, and the loop locates the new line by selecting line.wake === WAKE_ID, explicitly forbidding tail/last-by-position selection (line 133-134) and defining the no-match fallback to non-profitable narrate (line 135-136). Grounded in real source: run.sh:42 'WAKE="${WAKE_ID:-$(date -u +%s)}"' and run.sh:70 writes 'wake':'$WAKE' on the discover line (and every record_line path via lib/record.mjs at run.sh:54-55). The earn-ledger path contract is pinned to run.sh:41 'LEDGER="${EARN_LEDGER:-$HERE/state/earn-ledger.jsonl}"' (behavioral-spec.md:123-125), matching the cited default exactly.

priorFindingsCheck.priorFinding: iter2 verification_readiness #1 — central never-claim-unverified-earn invariant (isProfitable gate) had NO proof obligation; REQ-003 mapped only to PROP-015 + PROP-020
priorFindingsCheck.evidence: verification-architecture.md:61 PROP-021 ('isProfitable() earn classifier') asserts all five required cases: (a) tx+0x1+net>0+external=true+wake=WAKE_ID -> profitable:true; (b) no tx (discover) -> false; (c) status 0x0 -> false; (d) external:false (swap) -> false; (e) exit 0 with no WAKE_ID-matching line -> false; plus 'Exit code 0 alone NEVER produces profitable:true'. These match the real classifier skills/earn/lib/ledger.mjs:43-49 (tx && status==='0x1' && net_usdc>0 && external===true). PROP-021 is mapped under REQ-003 in the REQ->PROP table at verification-architecture.md:123 (REQ-003 | PROP-015, PROP-020, PROP-021).

nonBlockingNotes: behavioral-spec.md:139-144 reproduces isProfitable() with four conditions (tx + status 0x1 + net_usdc>0 + external===true) but omits the real classifier's fifth guard SWAP_SOURCES rejection (skills/earn/lib/ledger.mjs:46).
